author: GrapeSmoothie
body:
Quintus goes Green!

Creator: tel6331
Enforcer: lil_greg15
Support: glitchy1 & AviGill

If anyone has noticed in some Quintus matches there are sudden trees appearing. Staff and I have been planting trees on the map to make the map greener and players get a feeling that their in a jungle. Ive seen people say "why are there trees here .-."  and its kinda funny to see xD. This wont ruin the fun but to others they feel it looks better. If you want to support don't try to break the saplings while were trying to plant them. -Farmer Brown

*Approved by Glitchy1 :^).
